annotations.text:
Before

Five translucent layers per tile — blurred orbs, sheen, vignette, grain, then a white overlay reaching 96% at the bottom. The artwork dissolved into a stain.

Five beiges: page ground #cfc6ba, page background #f6f4f1, salary #f2ece4, compare #f0ebe4, charts #f8f5f0→#e9e0d5.

A gold (#e8d4b8, #c4a574) that exists nowhere in globals.css — and the real brand green sitting under all of it at 9%.

After — now live

No blur anywhere. Tokens only: #24382e (--eq-accent) as a field, #ffffff (--card), #ede9e3 (--secondary), on #f6f4f1 paper. The #cfc6ba ground is gone, so the overview sits on the same paper as every other page.

The hero bars are the real ranked figures at SDE1 · Madrid, on the same basis as the metric beside them — never invented proportions. The compare motif carries no magnitudes at all, only which side wins each row.

Same grid, same tiles, same copy.
